title: Earliest Skinwalker UFO images kept with full metadata

tellings.quote: even the earliest UFO images that were captured above Skinwalker Ranch under my stewardship, I have the metadata.

plain: Even the very first pictures of UFOs taken above Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, since he took it over around 2016 still have their full metadata, the hidden data that records when and how a photo was taken, says Brandon Fugal, the ranch's owner. Fugal tells it first-hand, as proof that the images can be checked.
